description.value: Ashoka Indian Cuisine is a full-service licensed restaurant in Langley, BC, serving a broad menu spanning traditional Indian street food, tandoor specialties, Indo-Chinese fusion, and momos alongside a full bar program with cocktails, mocktails, wine, and spirits. The kitchen caters to both vegetarians and meat-eaters with dedicated menu sections for each, and the restaurant also handles catering and accepts online orders.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 26m; stands (4 spaces) at 39m; bollard (2 spaces) at 96m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the business is open and operating at 20530 Fraser Hwy, Langley, BC V3A 4G2 with phone (604) 534-6344 not found in OSM. The website prominently advertises online takeout ordering ('Order Our Takeout Now and Save Big!') and includes a dedicated 'Vegetarian Specials' menu section with numerous vegetarian items, confirming those amenities. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Ashoka Restaurant' but the website consistently uses 'Ashoka Indian Cuisine'.
Phone number (604) 534-6344 is present on the website but absent from OSM tags; added from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Indian restaurant in Langley with confirmed website, address, and active online presence. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal with vegetarian options.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'Vegetarian Specials' section; individual vegetarian items appear throughout (Vegetable Pakora Platter, Vegetarian Pasta, Vegetable Samosa, Honey Chilli Cauliflower, etc.)

wow_evidence: full-service licensed restaurant in Langley, BC
